blockingIssues.description: Only 1 of 13 simple entities was migrated to extend generated services in this worker session (SupplierService). The other 10 simple entities (customers, products, purchases, abonos/payments, visitas, customer_groups, sale_items, purchase_items, distribucion_items, product_variants) still have fully manual implementations extending BaseService directly. The feature description explicitly required 'For each: generate service, ensure it compiles, update any manual service files to re-export or extend generated versions.' This was not achieved for the majority of entities.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the re-export fallback pattern for API-incompatible services: when a manual service cannot extend its generated counterpart due to API differences (enriched return types, custom methods), the fallback is to re-export the generated service with a renamed alias (e.g., 'export { CustomersService as CustomerService }'). This satisfies the migration requirement without breaking consumers.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: scale-migrate-simple-entities: VisitaService and CustomerGroupService were left fully manual because update() returns enriched types (VisitaWithCustomer, CustomerGroupSummary). A re-export pattern would have satisfied the feature requirement.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that generated services.ts must be regenerated after generator fixes. The fix-junction-table-service-generator feature fixed the generator but did not regenerate services.ts, leaving stale generated code in the app.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-junction-table-service-generator review: 'packages/app/app/lib/sync/generated/services.ts still contains the OLD pre-fix code for CustomerTagsService and CustomerGroupMembersService.'

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify schema naming conventions: manual services use snake_case field names (business_id, customer_id) in local type definitions while generated services use camelCase (businessId, customerId). This mismatch blocks extension for some entities.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: scale-migrate-simple-entities review: payment-service.ts defines Abono with snake_case fields while generated AbonosService uses camelCase.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that customer_group_members has an 'id' column (primaryKey with defaultRandom) and is NOT a junction table by the 'no id column' heuristic. Only customer_tags is a true junction table without 'id'.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-junction-table-service-generator review: customerGroupMembers schema has id: uuid('id').primaryKey().defaultRandom().
